template.name: Three Candle Bullish Engulfing
template.entry_long: close > donchian_high_prev(high,{p0}) and close > open and roc(close,{p1}) > {p0} and (open * roc(open,{p2}) - close * roc(close,1)) < {p1} * atr(high,low,close,14) and (open * roc(open,1) - close * roc(close,1)) > -30 * atr(high,low,close,14)
template.notes: With no bar shifting available, the three-candle pattern is rebuilt as a close above the prior two-bar high with a bullish body, an earlier up-leg (roc(close,2)>0) and a small prior body expressed through roc(open,1)/roc(close,1) versus 0.3 x ATR(14). The documented StopLossPerc 5 is used; TrailPerc 1.5, the 15:15 session exit and the optional RsiLevel 80 entry mode are not expressible.
